narrative:
Saab Aeronautics Net Sales in the Q3 Forecast is SEK 28.9B, +11.3% against the SEK 26.0B budget.

Gripen E/F is the largest programme at SEK 12.4B (43% of group). Advanced Pilot Training (T-7) is furthest ahead of plan (SEK 0.3B); Gripen E/F is furthest behind (SEK 1.2B).

Key risk: the Gripen E/F gap widens if the volume drivers on the Scenarios page move against plan.

signals.title: Q3 forecast SEK 0.92B below budget — Gripen E/F acceptance milestones slip into 2027
signals.source: SDP Revenue Planning — hours burned × revenue per hour, by programme
signals.excerpt: The Q3 forecast lands at SEK 28.95B against a SEK 29.87B budget (−3.1%). Gripen E/F is SEK 617M behind as acceptance milestones move into 2027; T-7 (−SEK 107M) and Special Mission Platforms (−SEK 92M) follow. Gripen C/D & Support is close to plan (−SEK 29M).

signals.title: Supplier inflation 4 points above contract indexation — Gripen E/F margin drifts 0.8pt
signals.source: SDP Programme Margin — estimate at completion vs contract price
signals.excerpt: Purchased components and subcontract work packages are running about 7% above last year while serial contracts index at about 3%. On the Gripen E/F estimate at completion that is a 0.8 percentage-point gross-margin drift, about SEK 240M in FY2026 before mitigation.

signals.title: SEK/USD at 0.095 — hedge book covers 78% of FY2026 USD purchases
signals.source: SDP Cost Drivers — FX exposure on engines and avionics
signals.excerpt: About a third of materials are bought in USD (engines, avionics). The hedge book covers 78% of FY2026 exposure; a 5% weaker krona on the open 22% costs about SEK 95M of gross profit.
